subject: Civic Education
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the importance of getting to know the customers and working well.
the_entrance: Introduction to the importance of satisfying customers.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Explain the concept of customer satisfaction and its importance.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Take notes on the importance of customer satisfaction.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group discussions on strategies to satisfy customers.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Participate in group discussions and share ideas.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitor group progress and correct misconceptions

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check or exit questions addressing all learning outcomes.
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
